Expected evidence: Quality and provenance exposed; invalid values quarantined; no discharge inference; FR-PHY-04

Trigger: Pump/link telemetry stale beyond approved threshold

Trigger: Cloud/edge loss with duplicate panel event replay
Expected evidence: Local automatic protection continues; one correlated effect; state/restoration history retained; FR-PHY-06

Expected evidence: No duplicate or expired actuation; no blind non-idempotent retry; reconciliation retained; FR-PHY-08

Expected evidence: Not succeeded; acceptance separated from physical evidence; UNKNOWN and deadline handling; FR-PHY-09

Trigger: Conflicting feedback while local operator takes over
Expected evidence: UNKNOWN assigned to named reconciler; remote conflict blocked; acknowledged handover and audit; FR-PHY-10

Trigger: Test request without approved physical isolation or with live credentials

Trigger: Impairment expires without physical restoration evidence

Trigger: Certificate from another site/model or unreviewed document revision
Expected evidence: Evidence scope mismatch fails gate; provenance/reviewer visible; FR-PHY-13

Trigger: Simulator PASS but SAT missing; then accepted firmware changes
Expected evidence: Production control blocked; affected acceptance invalidated until revalidation; FR-PHY-14

Trigger: Robot/water-monitor mission lacks operator or supported aiming/discharge capability
Expected evidence: Dependent actions denied; observe-only preserved; separate movement/aim/discharge authority; FR-PHY-15

Trigger: Mission loses link with stale position during operator handover
Expected evidence: UNKNOWN visible; approved local lost-link policy; no invented stop/return; acknowledged handover/outcome evidence; FR-PHY-16
